question_text: Choose the correct heading for: A
explanation: Choose the correct heading for each paragraph from the list of headings below.
source_reference: Official Guide to IELTS Academic Test 3
passage_text: High Speed, High Rise A Chinese entrepreneur has figured out a way to manufacture 30-story, earthquake-proof skyscrapers that snap together in just 15 days. A Zhang Yue is founder and chairman of Broad Sustainable Building (otherwise known as 'Broad') who, on 1 January, 2012, released a time-lapse video of its 30-story achievement.
